scope: Actual local Simulator Keychain integration using the exact shipping source, not MemorySessionVault

method.embeddedEntitlements: Mach-O __TEXT,__entitlements with own probe application identifier and sole probe Keychain group
method.hostCodeSignature: Local ad-hoc signature with own identifier; no restrictive iOS entitlement blob in the host signature
method.credentials: Only synthetic fixed-date sessions. No token values, private paths, or raw account data are included in this report.

limits: This validates the unchanged SessionVault implementation and Simulator entitlement mechanism in an isolated probe. It does not claim successful login, CAPTCHA, refresh against the remote service, or physical-device provisioning.
The physical IPA still requires the user's own Apple provisioning profile; this local Simulator signature is never used for an iPhone archive.
